messages:
alyssa: Woke up to a burn-rate alert on SLO 'inference-api:99th-latency' at 03:14. Where's the canonical dashboard + traces to check root cause? Any quick checks I should run before paging the infra oncall? @ben @sam :sleepy:

ben: Grafana panel here: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abcd123/slo-overview?orgId=1&panelId=7 - it shows burn rate by service and region. For traces use Jaeger: https://jaeger.redwood.internal/search?service=inference-api
Quick logs (Loki): `
{app="inference-api"} |= "ERROR" |~ "timeout|503|upstream"` over last 10m.
If you want an exact window, set from=now-15m to now and filter by trace_id from the grafana panel. :eyes:

deploy-bot: ALERT: SLO Burn Rate exceeded - inference-api:99th-latency - 122% over 1h. Alert rule: slo/burnrate/inference-api

alyssa: thanks, opening grafana now. I see a spike pinned to region-us-east-1. Any recent deploys? :thinking:

ben: no deploys in that window per deploy-bot. There's a config rollout yesterday but not in this timeframe. Start by grabbing the top traces and check for `kv-cache-miss` or batching delays. Also, if this is noisy, we can temporarily mute the alert or increase the `for` window.

sam: please don't change SLO thresholds without an incident review. If it's noisy, mute the alert for a short time and create a ticket. Mute command (internal):
```
# Observability CLI
obs-cli mute --alert slo/burnrate/inference-api --duration 30m --reason "investigating latency spike"
```

ben: ok muting for 20m while I run queries (muted by ben).

ben: logs show a tail of `upstream timeout` and 503s from model-proxy pods, traces show retries and inflated tail latency. Looks like a GPU node had degraded perf. Paging infra oncall.

noah: oncall here, I'll look into node health and pod restarts. Starting with `kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide` and checking node metrics (CPU/GPU util, temperature). I'll post findings. :mag:

noah: quick update: one g4dn node shows high GPU utilization and several OOM-killer events; kubelet restarted the model-proxy pod twice. I cordoned and draining that node. Expected recovery ~6m.

alyssa: thanks — I'll collect the top traces and attach to a ticket. Will re-open alert if it persists.

sam: created ticket SRE-5292 with links to grafana + jaeger traces and sample log queries. Tagging for postmortem if it doesn't stabilize. :spiral_note_pad:

alyssa: closing loop — after the drain the burn rate dropped to ~20% and the alert resolved. Leaving the mute for the remaining window. Thanks everyone. :tada:
